claims.claim: The delta transport was byte-identical to the dry-run transport and explicitly marked cloud-ok.

One complete reviewer accepted design-only and one partial reviewer provided a detailed acceptance analysis; the OpenRouter fallback was non-substantive and introduced a placeholder absent from the packet.
v1.1 is accepted only as a non-runtime generated-canary design contract.
No helper was built or spawned and no network, Keychain, YubiKey, provider, real credential, or live Codex configuration was touched by this design run.

the placeholder introduced by the OpenRouter response exists in source
